report_comment.text: BCAN encodes brevican. NTRK1 encodes TRKA, a neurotrophin receptor tyrosine kinase. The fusion joins BCAN to the retained NTRK1 kinase region. Chromosomal-engineering experiments produced high-grade gliomas in a p53-deficient background, supporting a cooperating oncogenic role. Oncogenic NTRK-fusion-positive advanced solid tumors can qualify for TRK inhibition; larotrectinib criteria include absence of known acquired TRK resistance mutations and prior progression or no satisfactory alternatives.
